purpose: Teach: つぶやく/励む/どうのこうの/苦笑い/こぞって/余程/あたらしい/どことなく

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、SNSでつぶやくの好きだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you actually like posting on social media, don't you?
lines.style: Playful, testing tone. Leans in with a slight smirk. Half-question, half-knowing accusation. Comfortable enough to tease without bite.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト前にちゃんと励むんだぞ、桜
lines.en: Hey — you study properly before the test, got it, Sakura?
lines.style: Slightly deflecting her jab with mock-seriousness. Quick, almost dismissive delivery. A laugh underneath it. Turns her advice back on her without quite meeting her eyes.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、どうのこうの言わずに勉強しろ
lines.en: Riku, stop talking and just study.
lines.style: Blunt, no-nonsense. Not unkind — just impatient with the deflection. Faster pace. The tone of someone who knows they're being avoided and isn't going to keep playing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、俺のジョークに苦笑いしてたな、桜
lines.en: You were laughing at my jokes, though. I saw that wry smile, Sakura.
lines.style: Softer now. Drawing her out gently. A small, genuine observation — not proving a point, just noticing. Quieter pace. The vulnerability of admitting he was paying attention.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、クラスのみんなが、こぞってお前を応援してたぞ
lines.en: Riku, the whole class was cheering you on.
lines.style: Warm, steady. Speaking a truth she noticed and wants him to know. No flourish — just clear delivery. A gift wrapped plainly, meant to land.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、余程ゲームが好きだな、桜
lines.en: You really do love games, don't you?
lines.style: Lighter tone, deflecting back at her now. A small smile in the voice — almost teasing, but underneath it, acceptance. The tone of someone admitting something without admitting it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のあたらしい自転車、かっこいいな
lines.en: Your new bike looks really cool.
lines.style: Direct admiration, no irony. The compliment lands simply and without fanfare. Brief, genuine. The tone of someone noticing something and saying it straight.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、どことなくお父さんに似てんな、桜
lines.en: You know, you're kind of like your dad in a lot of ways.
lines.style: Quiet realization spoken aloud. Gentle, almost tender. Slower pace. A moment of genuine seeing, not teasing. Trails slightly — wondering if he'll hear what she means underneath.
